name: Aura — AI Chief of Staff
page_note: AI executive assistant for planning, execution, and intelligent task management.
summary: AI executive assistant for planning, execution, and intelligent task management.

copy.what: Breaks a complex request into steps and runs the independent ones at the same time, coordinated as a team. Coordinated as a team under a Chief-of-Staff planner, not as separate disconnected agent calls.
why: A single advisor request — research, draft, follow-up — doesn't have to run as three separate manual steps.
